State 203 runs a dispatch loop: it invokes the callback object at this+0x8, then the dispatch object vtable entry at *(this+0x18C); on result 2 it copies this+0x7C to this+0x84 and hands off to BufferProcessingStateMachine, and for results 1/3 it increments the callback counter at *(this+0x8+4) and extends the callback limit at *(this+0x8+8) by this+0x118 when the counter reaches it.
